instruction: Set the number of undo levels in GIMP to 100 to preserve more editing history.

metadata.explanation: This task requires setting the undo levels to 100 in GIMP preferences. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for 'undo-levels 100' setting. Similar complexity to original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly locates and retrieves the GIMP gimprc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric properly parses gimprc format (handles comments, parentheses, key-value pairs) and checks for 'undo-levels' with value '100'
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter when type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('key') and expected.get('value')
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure settings are flushed to disk before verification
Complete coverage of the single instruction requirement: verify undo-levels is set to 100
Expected value '100' is semantically correct for GIMP undo-levels setting
Error handling is appropriate for edge cases (file not found, parse errors, None values)
